Becoming.LPO.of_rule.reason: A rule deciding every Boolean sequence gives the proposition LPO: pure logic; its run form is TailRuns.lpo_iff_runs with TailRuns.trueRule_iff.

Becoming.WLPO.of_rule.reason: A rule deciding every Boolean sequence gives the proposition WLPO: pure logic; its run form is TailRuns.wlpo_iff_runs with TailRuns.falseRule_iff.

Becoming.tailLaw_eq_wholeLaw.reason: A definitional identity of two constructed laws (the tail law is the law of the indicator of vanishing); the tail law's laws on webs are on the base (tailLaw_not_through, tailLaw_through_from, tailLaw_no_least_registration).

Becoming.vanishIndicator_changedByNoCond.reason: A fact about one constructed number, the indicator of vanishing given a decision; it serves only to read the tail law as a law of the whole.

Becoming.wholeLaw_not_readsFinitely.reason: A fact about the constructed law of a whole (one formation exchanging a number of the step-0 levels); its web form, not reading through what it is sensitive to on a free web, is joined as SensitivityWebs.wholeLaw_not_through.

Becoming.Pointer.no_list.reason: A fact about the constructed Pointer law (reads within no one list under all histories); it does not read naturally as a run or world.

Becoming.Pointer.readsFinitely.reason: A fact about the constructed Pointer law (reads finitely many conditions under each history).

Becoming.WLPO.of_lpo.reason: LPO gives WLPO: pure logic; both are stated of every run in TailRuns (lpo_iff_runs, wlpo_iff_runs).

Becoming.tailLaw_not_readsFinitely.reason: A fact about the tail law, one constructed law given a decision of vanishing.

Becoming.tailLaw_not_through_sensitive.reason: The history form of Becoming.tailLaw_not_through, which is on the base (the tail law does not read through what it is sensitive to on a web where it depends on nothing).

Becoming.Counts.eq_zero.reason: A list lemma: a count is zero where the determination holds of no member.

Becoming.Counts.pos_of_mem.reason: A list lemma: a member of which the determination holds makes a count positive.

Becoming.Decided.weakly.reason: A decided proposition is weakly decided: pure logic about excluded middle forms.

Becoming.exists_undominated_iff_weakly.reason: Asked of every relation, undominated members exist exactly under weak excluded middle: a statement about excluded middle only.

Becoming.undominated_has_iff_em.reason: Asked of every determination, the undominated law is exactly excluded middle: a statement about excluded middle only.

Becoming.Numbers.le_length.reason: A list lemma: the number of members a list holds is at most its length.

Becoming.Numbers.unique.reason: A list lemma: the number of members a list holds is one number; its world form through relations is joined as CensusWebs.indiscernible_numbers_unique.

Becoming.numbers_iff_decided.reason: A list lemma: a list's number of members exists exactly where identity among them is decided (local decidedness of list members, no structure of the unfolding).

Becoming.numbers_iff_numbersBy_eq.reason: A list lemma: counting by name is counting up to identity of names.

Becoming.of_listsOnce.reason: A list lemma: a law holding wherever a list is listed once holds where identity among its members is decided.

Becoming.repeated_same.reason: A list fact about [a, a] and [a]: length counts places, not members.

Becoming.listsOnce_all_iff.reason: Every list over a type can be listed once exactly where identity on the type is decided: a statement about decided equality only; the world form (World.indiscernible_decided_iff_em) is on the base.

Becoming.Triple.not_rearranged.reason: A fact about one constructed relation on three steps (first and last joined), not a world's footprint.

Becoming.pick_least.reason: A lemma about the sort's first-where search over Boolean freeness, used inside the normal form construction; no relation or world enters its statement.

Becoming.sorts_by_iff.reason: With the relation a world's footprint joins, it is Becoming.Footprinted.sorts_iff (on the base), through Footprinted.independent_iff_commutes.
